art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format is a high-velocity interruption designed to stop rapid, mindless tapping through Instagram Stories. The viewer is in a transient, impatient state, so a successful execution hits them with immediate, undeniable urgency and a visceral craving for the product before they can swipe away. It acts as a digital megaphone that feels thrilling and exclusive, turning a fleeting moment into an immediate transaction.
authored.platform_craft: The extreme verticality of the canvas demands a cascading visual hierarchy that pulls the eye from a striking focal point down through the offer details. Because a phone screen is held inches from the face, textures and macro details become hyper-intimate, but cluttered compositions quickly dissolve into visual noise. Work that ignores the platform's native UI elements risks having critical urgency triggers obscured by profile icons or reply bars.
genre_conventions: Treat the discount as the hero image's equal, giving the numbers architectural weight rather than treating them as an administrative afterthought.
Use intense color vibration or high-contrast palettes to create an optical alarm that signals a limited-time event without relying on cheap retail starbursts.
Integrate the urgency or deadline into the environment itself—projected on a wall, stamped into a surface, or glowing like neon—to make the time limit feel tangible.
Crop aggressively into the product to show intense material detail, making the item feel massive and premium even during a discount event.
art_direction_prompts: Harsh, cinematic spotlighting cutting through heavy atmospheric haze to isolate the product and the discount in a sea of deep shadow.
Hyper-saturated, glossy plastic textures paired with blinding, blown-out camera flash to evoke a frantic, paparazzi-style frenzy.
Macro-photography of the product heavily distorted through ribbed glass or chromatic aberration, creating a dizzying sense of high-speed motion.
A brutalist approach using scanned, torn paper edges, heavy ink bleed, and industrial hazard colors to make the sale feel like an underground, pirated event.
Drench the entire canvas in a single, vibrating neon flood-light, forcing the typography to punch through as thick, knockout silhouettes.
authored.typographic_character: Typography here must act as a loud, unapologetic architectural structure that anchors the fleeting nature of the sale. The visual tension relies on slamming massive, heavy-weight display characters for the discount against hyper-crisp, mechanical letterforms for the deadline. A sharp, expressive accent can be deployed to inject chaotic energy into the headline, making the offer feel like an unexpected disruption rather than a polite announcement.
failure_modes: Treating the discount and deadline as floating text layers rather than integral parts of the visual storytelling, which makes the layout feel like a template.
Relying on generic, centered lockups that lack tension, causing the eye to slide right off the canvas without registering the urgency.
Using flat, evenly lit product photography that strips the desirability away, making the sale feel like a desperate clearance bin rather than an exclusive event.
Ignoring the verticality of the canvas by simply stacking disconnected horizontal bands of information, resulting in a static, uninspired reading experience.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format is the digital equivalent of a grand unveiling, designed to stop a rapid thumb-scroll dead in its tracks. The viewer is actively swiping through a high-velocity feed, meaning a strong execution must command immediate visceral intrigue before the brain even registers the product category. It transforms a standard announcement into an event, making the arrival of a new product feel urgent, tactile, and impossible to ignore.
authored.platform_craft: The 4:5 aspect ratio offers a towering, immersive window on mobile screens, demanding vertical tension and a visual hierarchy that pulls the eye deliberately through the canvas. Because it is viewed at arm's length on a glaring screen, intricate, whisper-thin details are instantly swallowed by compression and motion. Attention naturally hits the center-mass first before scanning for context, meaning an overly scattered composition will collapse into visual noise.
genre_conventions: Treat the product as a monumental hero, scaling it to feel physically imposing and structurally dominant within the vertical frame.
Create a distinct atmosphere that signals absolute newness, using high-contrast drama, unexpected color vibrations, or surreal staging to break the feed's monotony.
Fuse the typography and the imagery so they interact physically, letting letterforms tuck behind, weave through, or warp around the product to build deep spatial layers.
Prioritize a single, aggressive focal point that forces the viewer to process the key benefit in a fraction of a second.
art_direction_prompts: Bask the product in a harsh, neon-drenched rim light against a pitch-black void to make the silhouette feel electric and alien.
Suspend the object mid-air surrounded by exploding shards of raw material—glass, stone, or liquid—frozen by a high-speed flash.
Shoot the product through heavy, distorted ribbed glass, revealing only a sharp, fiercely saturated sliver of the key feature.
Flood the entire canvas in a single, hyper-saturated monochrome color, letting deep, inky shadows carve out the product's geometry.
Use intense, theatrical spotlighting from directly above, casting a stark, graphic shadow that anchors the composition and leaves the edges in cinematic darkness.
authored.typographic_character: Typography here needs to act as a loud, confident herald, carrying the weight of the announcement with unapologetic structural presence. The interplay between a brutally heavy, industrial headline and a razor-sharp, highly legible secondary typeface creates a striking friction. Let an expressive, wildly stylized accent cut through the rigid structure to inject a burst of raw energy right where the eye needs to land.
failure_modes: Treating the canvas like a static catalog page, where the product floats aimlessly in a white void without any environmental tension.
Timid, apologetic typography that cowers in the corners, making the launch feel like a footnote rather than a major event.
Overcrowding the vertical space with competing visual elements, leaving the viewer's eye bouncing frantically without a clear resting place.
Relying on flat, even, shadowless lighting that strips the product of its tactile reality and turns it into a cheap vector graphic.

authored.format_character: This format turns a verbal statement into a highly collectable visual artifact for a viewer who is actively curating their aspirations on crowded boards. A strong example transcends mere reading material, becoming a textural, atmospheric object that demands to be pinned and saved. It anchors the brand's voice in an undeniable mood that feels like a rare find rather than an advertisement.
authored.platform_craft: The tall canvas acts as a digital poster that must survive as a dense, high-contrast thumbnail within a crowded masonry grid. Attention lands squarely on the macro-silhouette of the typographic block before a single word is deciphered. Fragile, spindly compositions dissolve completely at this scale, whereas bold, structural anchoring forces the scrolling thumb to stop and click.
genre_conventions: Treat the quote as a physical element interacting with the environment—casting shadows, glowing, or integrating into the grain of the imagery rather than floating weightlessly above it.
Give the attribution the swagger of an artist's signature or a gallery placard, wielding a distinct character that complements the primary statement.
Anchor the brand name with deliberate gravity, treating it like a hallmark or publisher's imprint that grounds the composition in authority.
Aim for rich, saturated macro-contrasts where the interplay between deep shadows and bright highlights carves out the typographic hierarchy.
art_direction_prompts: Text heavily debossed into thick, impasto oil paint under harsh, direct gallery lighting.
Luminous typography bleeding into a dense, foggy cinematic night scene, casting a colored glow onto the brand name.
High-contrast, hard-flash photography where the quote feels physically sliced out of a glossy editorial spread.

Rich, velvety darkroom aesthetics where the statement emerges from deep, inky shadows like a photograph slowly developing in a tray.
authored.typographic_character: The quote itself must carry the booming voice and structural weight, acting as the undeniable, sculptural hero of the layout. The attribution provides a sharp, contrasting texture—perhaps an expressive flourish or a rigid industrial stamp—giving the eye a distinct secondary resting place. The brand name operates as the steady, reliable bedrock, vibrating with deliberate authority at the perimeter to frame the entire conversation.
failure_modes: Slapping flat, weightless typography over an image without any environmental interaction, resulting in a cheap, disposable meme aesthetic.
Treating the quote, attribution, and brand with the exact same typographic voice, turning a dynamic statement into a monotonous drone.
Creating compositions so airy, fragile, and delicate that they vanish entirely into the visual noise of the Pinterest grid.
Tucking the brand name away like a shameful apology, rather than treating it as a proud, deliberate hallmark of the piece.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format acts as a cinematic billboard interrupting a fast, thumb-driven feed to sell the energy of an upcoming gathering. The viewer is passively scrolling; a strong announcement jolts them out of their routine, making them feel the atmosphere of the room before they even read the details. It transforms a logistical payload into a highly anticipated destination.
authored.platform_craft: The wide, horizontal expanse of this canvas begs for a sweeping composition where the eye is caught by a bold focal point and naturally drifts across the remaining space to collect the details. At mobile viewing distances, intricate background noise turns to mush, demanding decisive contrast and shapes that read instantly at the scale of a postage stamp. If the visual hook doesn't immediately hand the baton to the event name, the viewer has already scrolled past.
genre_conventions: Establish a tangible, immersive atmosphere that telegraphs the event's specific energy—whether nocturnal, academic, chaotic, or celebratory—before a single word is processed.
Group the logistical payload (date, time, location) into a tightly unified, effortlessly scannable lockup rather than scattering pieces across the canvas.
Allow the Event Name to interact physically with the environment, wrapping around objects, casting shadows, or hiding partially behind foreground elements to build depth.
Leverage environmental lighting and rich material textures to make the event feel like a physical, lived-in space rather than flat data on a screen.
art_direction_prompts: High-contrast, neon-drenched rim lighting cutting through heavy atmospheric fog to reveal a central, symbolic object.
Crisp, hyper-focused macro photography of a rugged material—like cracked leather, oxidized copper, or wet asphalt—serving as a tactile stage.
A frenetic, multi-layered collage using ripped paper edges, halftone photography, and a saturated, aggressive spot color to create chaotic energy.
Harsh, directional sunlight at a low angle casting elongated, graphic shadows across a vibrant, solid-color architectural backdrop.
Event details etched into glowing, translucent glass suspended over a deep, dark, cavernous void.
authored.typographic_character: The Event Name must act as the loud, charismatic host of the party, carrying the heaviest visual weight and setting the stylistic attitude. The logistical details should behave like an impeccably dressed concierge—crisp, highly legible, and tightly organized, providing a sharp, functional contrast to the expressive title. An accent voice, like a raw handwritten scrawl or a utilitarian industrial stamp, can inject a sudden burst of urgency or exclusivity.
failure_modes: Treating the date, time, and location as an afterthought, leaving them floating aimlessly in corners and creating a frustrating visual scavenger hunt.
Relying on flat, lifeless stock photography slapped with a generic color wash, instantly stripping the event of any unique personality.
Assigning equal visual weight to the Event Name and the logistical details, resulting in a monotonous wall of text where nothing commands attention.
Ignoring the horizontal sweep of the canvas by cramming all visual tension into the center, leaving the outer edges feeling abandoned and unresolved.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format is the digital equivalent of a flagship store window, designed to arrest the endless scroll by commanding maximum vertical screen real estate. The viewer is moving fast through a crowded feed, meaning a strong drop announcement must hit them with an immediate, undeniable mood before they even read the copy. A successful execution translates the raw energy of a new release into a singular, scroll-stopping visual punch that demands deeper investigation.
authored.platform_craft: The 4:5 canvas rewards vertical tension and dramatic cropping, pushing the viewer's eye up and down the frame rather than letting it rest passively in the center. Because this will be viewed on a brightly lit phone screen at arm's length, high-contrast focal points and bold silhouettes win over intricate background details that turn to mush at thumbnail scale. Attention typically strikes the deepest point of contrast first, so the interplay between the collection's hero imagery and the brand's typographic anchor must be instantly legible.
genre_conventions: Treat the collection name as a monumental event rather than a mere label, giving it the structural presence of a movie title.
Build a distinct environmental world around the product—whether through extreme macro textures or vast atmospheric depth—so the drop feels like an arrival into a new space.
Leverage the tagline to inject attitude or narrative friction, rather than just describing what the product is.
Establish a clear visual hierarchy where the brand name acts as a confident signature anchoring the explosive energy of the new release.
art_direction_prompts: Harsh, theatrical spotlighting cutting through a dense, cinematic fog to reveal the product's edge.
Hyper-saturated, blown-out flash photography that flattens the subject against a high-gloss, vibrating background.
Thick, tactile materials—like crushed velvet or raw industrial steel—shot at extreme macro to create a landscape of texture behind the typography.
A kinetic, motion-blurred hero image where the product feels like it's speeding past the lens, anchored by razor-sharp, static typography.
Deep, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting where the product emerges from heavy, crushing shadows, forcing the viewer to lean in.
authored.typographic_character: The typography should carry the swagger of a blockbuster premiere, with the collection name acting as the heavy, undeniable protagonist of the space. Contrast this massive, structural weight with a tagline that feels sharp, urgent, and highly stylized—perhaps a stinging italic or an aggressive, mechanical cut. The brand name must sit with absolute authority, acting as the grounded foundation that allows the rest of the type to flex and scream.
failure_modes: Treating the collection name like a polite afterthought tucked into a corner, draining the drop of its event-level energy.
Relying on flat, even studio lighting that makes the new product look like a catalog commodity rather than an object of desire.
Floating the tagline in negative space without any relationship to the imagery, making it feel like a sticker slapped on at the last minute.
Creating a composition so perfectly balanced and symmetrical that it lacks the visual tension necessary to stop a fast-scrolling thumb.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format exists to inject human credibility into a dense, professional feed where users are aggressively scrolling for career or industry leverage. A strong execution stops the thumb by making the subject feel like a peer offering an insider secret, rather than a corporate mouthpiece. It turns a quoted claim into a tangible piece of evidence that feels earned, authoritative, and deeply authentic.
authored.platform_craft: The 5:4 canvas offers a tall, immersive window on mobile that demands an immediate, singular focal point before the eye wanders to the platform's UI framing. Because it is viewed on small, brightly lit screens in transit, high-contrast structural hierarchy is non-negotiable; complex, low-contrast layering turns to mud at a glance. Attention lands on the human element first—whether a piercing gaze or a booming typographic voice—so abstract background filler fails instantly.
genre_conventions: Treat the quotation marks or attribution glyphs as active, structural architecture rather than afterthoughts, giving the voice a physical anchor in the composition.
Ensure the person's portrait or environmental context feels like a captured moment of expertise, favoring active, candid energy over stiff, studio-lit headshots.
Create a distinct, immediate visual separation between the core insight of the quote and the credentials, allowing the viewer to absorb the value before verifying the source.
Use the subject's industry or environment to inform the textural backdrop, grounding the testimonial in a specific, lived reality rather than a sterile void.
art_direction_prompts: Harsh, cinematic chiaroscuro lighting that carves the subject out of deep shadows, treating them like a visionary rather than a middle manager.
A tactile, analog aesthetic using heavy film grain, light leaks, and slightly misregistered typography to suggest a raw, unfiltered documentary truth.
Hyper-crisp, macro-lens depth of field where the typography rests on a pane of glass hovering just inches above a richly textured, out-of-focus industrial material.
Vibrant, saturated color blocking with hard-edge geometry that frames the subject's face like a contemporary editorial magazine cover.
Soft, diffuse morning light filtering through blinds, casting rhythmic, linear shadows across the typographic lockup to imply a quiet moment of revelation.
authored.typographic_character: The testimonial itself must speak with undeniable confidence, carrying the visual weight of a headline through muscular, tightly leaded letterforms that demand to be read. Contrast this heavy lifting with crisp, utilitarian tracking for the name and title, treating the credentials like the precise legend on a map. An expressive, idiosyncratic accent—perhaps an oversized, stylized quotation mark or a signature-like script for the name—can inject a sudden flash of personality into the structural rigor.
failure_modes: Floating a tiny, isolated headshot in a massive sea of negative space, making the customer look insignificant and the layout feel accidental.
Treating the quote like a legal disclaimer, resulting in a dense, uninviting block of text that viewers will instantly scroll past.
Relying on generic corporate lifestyle photography that looks like a stock image, instantly destroying the trust the testimonial is meant to build.
Stacking the quote, name, and title in a single, undifferentiated column of text, leaving the eye with no clue where the insight ends and the metadata begins.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format is a beacon for talent scrolling through a dense, fast-moving feed, designed to interrupt their casual browsing with a sudden career possibility. The viewer is likely passively consuming visual content, so a strong example must instantly telegraph ambition and culture before they even read the job title. It transforms a standard corporate utility into a highly charged invitation to step into a vibrant, compelling new world.
authored.platform_craft: The 1:1 square demands immediate, central gravity or strict structural tension to prevent the eye from slipping off the edges of the screen. Because this is viewed at arm’s length on a glaring mobile display, high-contrast anchors and aggressive scale shifts are essential to stop the thumb. What fails here is a polite, uniform distribution of weight—if the core message does not punch through the surrounding visual noise instantly, the post is already dead.
genre_conventions: Treating the Job Title as a monolithic hero element and a piece of structural art, rather than administrative data to be filed away.
Using environmental or atmospheric imagery that sells the raw energy of the workplace, avoiding staged corporate pantomime.
Creating a clear, magnetic visual hierarchy where the Apply Link feels like a tactile, irresistible destination rather than an afterthought.
Infusing the company identity through bold color blocking or expressive graphic motifs that make the post distinctly recognizable in the feed.
art_direction_prompts: Bathe the scene in neon-tinged, cinematic rim lighting that suggests late-night innovation and high-stakes creative energy.
Construct a tactile, hyper-real collage using torn paper textures, heavy grain, and halftone photo treatments to project a gritty, hands-on maker culture.
Use macro-photography of lush, organic materials—like polished stone, dense foliage, or poured glass—as a backdrop to imply a premium, deeply considered environment.
Deploy aggressive, kinetic motion blur on background elements, freezing only the sharp, crisp typography of the job title in the foreground to communicate extreme momentum.
Build a hyper-saturated, surreal gradient mesh that feels like a glowing aura, framing an inset team photo that bursts out of its container with high-flash, direct-camera attitude.
authored.typographic_character: The typography must carry the booming voice of a recruiter shouting across a crowded room, with the Job Title acting as the undisputed, heavy-hitting champion of the layout. Contrast is your weapon here: pit a brutal, wide structural typeface against a sharp, hyper-expressive script or a mechanical mono-spaced accent for the Location. The character should feel urgent and monumental, turning the act of hiring into a headline event.
failure_modes: Treating the canvas like a text document by stacking the title, company, location, and link in a polite, uniform list that lacks any visual tension.
Relying on literal business imagery—like handshakes, empty desks, or glowing lightbulbs—which instantly signals a soulless corporate void.
Burying the apply link in the exact same typographic weight as the location, removing any sense of action or destination.
Failing to establish a distinct light source or atmospheric depth, resulting in a flat, clinical graphic that feels like a generic, mass-produced template.

Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: This format is an environmental beacon meant to interrupt a pedestrian's transit with the immediate electricity of something new arriving in their physical space. The viewer is typically in motion, meaning a strong execution acts as a visual speed bump that instantly registers the event before drawing them into the details. A triumphant example makes the opening feel like an unmissable local milestone rather than a standard retail promotion.
authored.platform_craft: The extreme verticality of this canvas demands an aggressive vertical rhythm where the eye is pulled from a towering focal point down through cascading information. Because this is viewed from a distance in brightly lit physical environments, high-contrast structural blocking is essential for legibility, while intricate, low-contrast details will completely wash out. Attention usually strikes the upper third first, making it the prime real estate for your most magnetic visual hook or the primary announcement headline.
genre_conventions: Celebrate the threshold: Strong work visualizes the energy of doors unlocking, curtains dropping, or the very first burst of light hitting a new space.
Hyper-local anchoring: Ground the announcement in its physical reality, making the location feel like a celebrated destination rather than just a mailing address.
Event-level urgency: The visual language should telegraph a momentary spectacle—something happening right now—rather than an evergreen brand awareness campaign.
Material anticipation: Use rich, tactile textures that make the viewer want to physically step into the environment being advertised.
art_direction_prompts: Flood the canvas with a hyper-saturated, theatrical spotlight cutting through deep atmospheric haze to reveal the business name.
Treat the screen like a physical construction site, using high-gloss industrial materials, caution-tape yellow accents, and heavy metallic textures that feel freshly installed.
Use a macro, shallow-depth-of-field photograph of the product or interior with a harsh, raking flash that creates razor-sharp shadows and intense specular highlights.
Frame the composition as a torn-paper wheatpaste poster, complete with curled edges, heavy grain, and the raw, tactile grit of street-level anticipation.
Bathe the entire composition in a neon-drenched, cinematic twilight, making the opening date glow like a physical marquee sign against a dark, moody backdrop.
authored.typographic_character: Typography here must act as a loud, structural scaffolding that holds its own against intense environmental distractions. The primary headline should carry a booming, monumental weight that commands the street, while the location and date can operate as sharp, hyper-legible utility text that cuts through the visual noise. Consider introducing a highly expressive, hand-hewn, or calligraphic accent to inject a burst of human energy into the rigid architecture of the announcement.
failure_modes: Treating the tall canvas like a printed flyer, resulting in a static, evenly spaced list of facts that lacks any dramatic focal hierarchy.
Relying on flat, dimensionless graphics that fail to compete with the rich, physical reality of the street or mall surrounding the screen.
Burying the opening date and location in decorative, low-contrast treatments that become completely invisible to a pedestrian walking briskly past the display.
Defaulting to generic stock imagery of smiling people instead of leaning into the specific, tactile reality of the new space, product, or brand.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

art_direction_prompts: Choose ONE decisive lighting design and commit to it: hard key with a crisp rim/edge highlight, dramatic side light with deep falloff, or a bright airy high-key set. State direction, quality (hard or soft) and colour temperature, and include real speculars and controlled shadow falloff. Flat, even, all-round illumination is the clearest single signal of a generic AI render.

Put the subject in a real SET, not a void: a tangible surface with visible texture, a believable environment behind it, and depth cues such as foreground occlusion or atmospheric falloff. A plain neutral gradient backdrop reads as empty and unfinished.

Describe material response explicitly — how glass refracts and catches edge light, how metal throws speculars, how condensation beads and runs, how fabric absorbs light. Material behaviour is what makes a render read as a photograph.

Non-claim product dressing IS permitted and encouraged: a designed label, cap, embossing, texture or packaging typography. This invents no verifiable fact and is a major part of why a product reads as real rather than as a blank prop. Keep any invented label copy to 2–4 short words so it renders cleanly. NEVER invent awards, certifications, percentages, health claims, or origin claims.

Contextual elements that support the product story — garnish, ingredients, ice, steam, utensils, surface detail, props — are permitted unless the user excluded them. They supply the richness that separates premium work from stock imagery. Do not strip the scene back to the bare subject by default.

authored.format_character: The viewer is rapidly scrolling through a visually dense, chaotic feed of video content, making split-second decisions about what deserves their attention. This format acts as a high-contrast billboard that must arrest that scroll, instantly communicating a digital tool or game that promises immediate utility or joy. A strong execution transforms a flat interface into a visceral, tactile experience that makes the act of downloading feel like an irresistible, urgent upgrade to their digital life.
authored.platform_craft: The 16:9 canvas at thumbnail scale is notoriously unforgiving, often viewed at the size of a postage stamp on mobile devices where intricate details immediately vanish. Attention lands violently on the area of highest contrast before scanning for context, demanding bold, singular focal points over scattered elements. Relying on literal, complex screenshots of the app UI is a guaranteed failure at this scale; the interface must be aggressively stylized and distilled to its most iconic, readable essence.
genre_conventions: Dramatize the digital: treat the app interface like a physical, luminous object interacting with its environment, casting light, shadow, and reflection.
Aggressive hierarchy: the main benefit must punch through the noise instantly, using extreme weight and scale to dominate the read.
Tactile interaction cues: make buttons and platform badges feel clickable, dimensional, and deeply integrated into the world of the composition.
Hyper-concentrated UI: distill the app's interface down to its most recognizable, hero features rather than showing a literal, messy screenshot.
art_direction_prompts: A harsh, theatrical spotlight punching through a dark, smoky void to hit a glossy phone screen, making the app's UI colors bleed into the shadows.
Extreme macro photography of a glass screen, where the app's typography bends and refracts through the thick, beveled edges of the device.
A kinetic, anti-gravity explosion of 3D UI elements bursting out of the device frame, frozen in mid-air with a deep, cinematic depth of field.
Saturated, neon rim-lighting wrapping around a heavily textured, gritty backdrop, creating a high-contrast silhouette of the app interface.
A surreal, monochromatic environment where the only source of vibrant, saturated color radiates directly from the app's hero feature like a beacon.
authored.typographic_character: The typography here needs to scream over the visual noise of YouTube, carrying the primary weight through muscular, unapologetic letterforms that demand to be read. Tension is created by slamming these booming, heavy benefit statements against razor-sharp, technical accents used for platform availability and app names. Treat the button text as a concentrated burst of energy—it should feel active, urgent, and distinct from the structural type anchoring the composition.
failure_modes: Dropping a flat, unedited screenshot into a device frame, making the app feel lifeless, generic, and impossible to read on a mobile screen.
Spreading visual weight too evenly across the canvas, resulting in a polite, muddy composition that gets swallowed by the YouTube feed.
Treating the CTA button as an afterthought or a flat sticker, rather than an irresistible, dimensional object begging to be pressed.
Ignoring the dense nature of the YouTube interface, leading to critical information being covered by native timestamps or platform overlays.

authored.format_character: This format functions as a digital marquee, often greeting a captive audience waiting for a session to begin or serving as a promotional bumper within a larger deck. The viewer is scanning for relevance and validation of their time investment. A strong execution builds immediate anticipation, framing the event not just as a meeting, but as an unmissable broadcast.
authored.platform_craft: The 4:3 canvas offers a classically cinematic, slightly boxy frame that demands a strong anchor point to prevent the composition from floating. Because this is often viewed on varying laptop screens or compressed through video conferencing software, extreme high-contrast anchoring is essential for legibility. Attention naturally gravitates toward human features or the heaviest typographic mass first; treating this space like a standard document page rather than a broadcast graphic will instantly kill the energy.
genre_conventions: Treating the speaker portrait as editorial photography rather than a corporate headshot—using bold cropping, aggressive color grading, or deep integration with the background to build undeniable authority.
Establishing a distinct typographic hierarchy where the event title acts as an explosive billboard, while logistical details like date and time feel like precision instruments.
Using structural graphic elements—such as heavy framing, striking color blocks, or dimensional staging—to elevate the event from a standard calendar invite to a premium experience.
Ensuring the time and date carry enough visual weight to be registered in a three-second glance without competing with the main thematic hook.
art_direction_prompts: Heavy, saturated gradient meshes that feel like glowing neon tubes bleeding into a dark void, pushing the speaker portrait into high-drama silhouette.
Tactile, brutalist structural elements—think thick, glossy acrylic panels overlapping rough matte paper textures, casting harsh, dense drop shadows.
A cinematic, single-source spotlight effect cutting diagonally across the canvas, illuminating the title and speaker while letting secondary details fall into rich, warm darkness.
Hyper-kinetic typography that stretches and bleeds off the edges of the frame, treating the canvas as a window into a much larger, moving environment.
Duotone or false-color portrait treatments that strip away corporate realism, replacing it with aggressive, high-energy brand colors that vibrate against a stark background.
authored.typographic_character: The webinar title must carry the swagger of a marquee, acting as the undisputed heavyweight champion of the layout. Contrast is your primary weapon here: pair a brutally thick, commanding display face for the hook with a hyper-crisp, technical typeface for the date and time logistics. An unexpected typographic accent—perhaps a sweeping italic or a sharply flared letterform for the speaker's name—can inject sudden personality into an otherwise highly structured informational hierarchy.
failure_modes: Dropping a poorly lit, unedited corporate headshot into a floating circle, instantly degrading the speaker's authority and making the event feel cheap.
Giving the title, speaker name, and date the exact same visual weight, forcing the viewer to read the entire slide just to understand what they are looking at.
Relying on a flat, generic stock photo background that has no conceptual relationship to the content, making the event feel mass-produced.
Treating the space like a word processor document with edge-to-edge text, rather than a dynamic stage with intentional tension between positive and negative areas.
